details:
This is an issue I first noticed in December during vket when I got <5 fps out of nowhere, the only one in my group impacted and it cleared up on reatarting the client. This issue recently got dramatically worse during the last client update and now happens once per night. In the logs, there is no indication of anything going wrong in Udon and CPU usage is normal, but there is an entry for “Websocket Exploded” that correlates to when I got sudden increase in CPU frame time (from 4ms to 50+ ms) and again, the issue does not go away until restarting the client.

This just happened again tonight, and it looks like it correlates to these lines in the logs:
